description: Leading a team of engineers building the Data Mesh Platform on Azure Databricks, ADF, and ADLS Gen2, delivering data products that power analytics and AI/ML models across 29 global markets.
Leading data infrastructure for Para OS, a Digital Twin and IoT telemetry platform holding a UL Smart Systems Platinum certification, processing billions of telemetry records.
Built and maintained Airflow data pipelines supporting enterprise clients including Google, Apple, and ServiceNow.
Designed and maintained backend systems and APIs, establishing the core services that later data engineering work was built on.
